title: SECTION 2, UNIT 1
subtitle: Differentiate high-risk brand look-alikes (Humalog/Humulin R, NovoLOG/NovoLIN R, ZyPREXA/ZyrTEC, TopAMAX/Toprol-XL) documented in ISMP MERP.

lasaPairs.feature: Timing/onset mismatch leading to acute postprandial hyperglycemia followed by severe, delayed hypoglycemia.
Mismatch in onset and peak activity causing unpredictable blood glucose fluctuations and severe hypoglycemia.
Unexpected insulin peaks causing severe nighttime hypoglycemic shock or loss of glycemic control.
Loss of seizure control or mood instability vs. untreated fungal infection and hepatotoxicity risks; lamotrigine carries black-box risks of Stevens-Johnson syndrome.
Severe central nervous system sedation, orthostatic hypotension, falls, and metabolic disturbances in patients needing a simple allergy tablet.
Severe bradycardia, heart block, or rebound hypertension vs. cognitive slowing, metabolic acidosis, and breakthrough seizures.
Tricyclic overdose symptoms (cardiac arrhythmias, QRS widening, anticholinergic toxidrome) or extrapyramidal and metabolic symptoms.
Neuropsychiatric disruption, drug-induced tremor/insomnia, or failed suppression of severe peptic ulcer bleeding.
Dosing difference (tenecteplase is a single weight-based bolus, alteplase is a bolus plus infusion); errors cause massive intracranial hemorrhage or subtherapeutic thrombolysis in stroke/MI.
Profound myelosuppression, leukopenia, and thrombocytopenia from unintended cytotoxic hydroxyurea administration.
Severe embryofetal toxicity, deep vein thrombosis/pulmonary embolism, and intense cytopenias from lenalidomide.
Profound sedation, severe bradycardia, and hypotension from dexmedetomidine, or acute glycemic decompensation and immune suppression from dexamethasone.
